fields.description: Central Park Plaza is a two-tower residential phase at Central Park, City Walk. Its range includes apartments, four-bedroom townhouses and five-bedroom penthouses across three levels. The layouts combine enclosed rooms with balconies or terraces in an urban park setting.

overview: The plans distinguish townhouse, duplex and penthouse arrangements. Large balconies and penthouse terraces form part of total area; a single bedroom-wide size range would conceal important layout differences.
research.locationNote: At Central Park in City Walk, Dubai, as established by the own phase brochure.  Facilities are shared and views vary by unit.
research.priceNote: The official 2023 sheet starts at AED 2.73m for one bedroom, 3.76m for two, 7.09m for three, 12.43m for four, 19.50m for a four-bedroom townhouse and 31.72m for a five-bedroom penthouse. These are historical launch tiers. The community page still displays 2.73m; obtain a current unit quote.
research.paymentNote: The original developer sheet specifies 20% booking; five 10% instalments in March/September 2024, March/September 2025 and March 2026; then 30% July 2027 on handover. This historical calendar does not establish today’s unpaid balance or resale terms.
research.handoverNote: The official sheet estimates July 2027, shown as Q3 2027. Property Finder gives October 2026. The developer community page reports 43.68% at 1 September 2026; neither marketing availability nor a portal date proves completion.
